name: regsession
help: Enumerate logged-on user SIDs from HKEY_USERS registry hive
long_help: Enumerates the HKEY_USERS registry hive to find user SIDs (S-1-5-21-*), indicating active user sessions. Can query local or remote systems. Useful for identifying which users have loaded registry profiles on a system.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Target hostname or IP for remote query (empty for local)
